## Invitations

The outreach process issued 7112 invitations during the reporting period. Attendance was recorded for 4737 invitees, representing a reported rate of 66.6. These figures provide the basis for reviewing the reach of the invitation activity and the level of participation achieved. The attendance result should be considered alongside the communication methods used to support engagement. The figures are presented as recorded and provide a clear summary of invitation and attendance activity.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 6021 invitees. The recorded reminder figure was 0. This indicates that SMS was the principal reported contact activity, while no reminders were recorded in the information provided. Together, the contact figures describe the communication undertaken in support of the invitations and attendance. They also provide a straightforward reference for future review of outreach arrangements and follow-up activity.
